articles.title: Kushinagar Shock: Artist Playing Lord Shiva Dies Mid-Tableau, Heart Attack Suspected
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Kushinagar, UP – Tragedy struck during the Dol Mela tableau when a young artist portraying Lord Shiva collapsed on stage and died suddenly. The incident caused chaos among spectators and fellow performers. The artist was dancing to DJ music when he suddenly fell unconscious.

body.html:
Kushinagar, UP – Tragedy struck during the Dol Mela tableau when a young artist portraying Lord Shiva collapsed on stage and died suddenly. The incident caused chaos among spectators and fellow performers.

The artist was dancing to DJ music when he suddenly fell unconscious. Initial suspicion points to a silent heart attack, though the exact cause will be confirmed after post-mortem.

The incident has once again raised alarm over the rising number of heart attack-related deaths. Questions are being asked whether factors like loud DJ music or negligence in health checks contributed to the tragedy.

articles.title: Greater Noida Dowry Death Case: Video Shows In-Laws at Funeral, Father-in-Law Lit Pyre
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Greater Noida – New developments have cast doubt on the version given by the family of 28-year-old Nikki Bhati, who was allegedly set ablaze for dowry in Sirsa village last Thursday.

body.html:
Greater Noida – New developments have cast doubt on the version given by the family of 28-year-old Nikki Bhati, who was allegedly set ablaze for dowry in Sirsa village last Thursday.

Nikki’s sister Kanchan had claimed her husband Vipin and other in-laws poured a liquid on Nikki and set her on fire, before fleeing. Nikki’s father also alleged that except the father-in-law, all in-laws ran away after the incident.

However, a video of Nikki’s funeral shows her father-in-law and some family members of her husband attending the rites, with the father-in-law himself lighting the pyre.

Later, at 12:40 pm on Friday, an FIR was lodged naming Nikki’s husband Vipin, her brother-in-law Rohit, and her parents-in-law. All four have since been arrested. Vipin was shot in the leg during arrest after allegedly trying to snatch a policeman’s pistol.

Earlier videos had surfaced showing Vipin dragging Nikki by her hair, followed by disturbing clips of Nikki on fire and struggling with severe burns.

Kanchan also alleged that both sisters were harassed for ₹36 lakh as additional dowry. She said she was assaulted for hours the same night and fainted after witnessing her sister being set ablaze.

The case has triggered outrage, with calls for strict action against dowry-related violence.

articles.title: ₹1948 Crore Prayagraj Mega Bridge Shaken Again – Truck & Container Collapse During Loading
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Prayagraj, UP – A major accident occurred during construction of the country’s second longest bridge on the Ganga. While heavy concrete structures were being loaded onto a cargo ship using cranes, a truck and container lost balance and overturned into the river.

body.html:
Prayagraj, UP – A major accident occurred during construction of the country’s second longest bridge on the Ganga. While heavy concrete structures were being loaded onto a cargo ship using cranes, a truck and container lost balance and overturned into the river. Workers fled in panic, but fortunately, no casualties were reported.

The 9.9 km long bridge, connecting Bailey Road to Malaka near Phaphamau, is being built at a cost of ₹1948 crore by SP Singla Construction Pvt. Ltd. The project was inaugurated in November 2020 by Union Minister Nitin Gadkari and CM Yogi Adityanath.

The incident, captured on video on Monday evening, has raised fresh concerns over safety standards at the under-construction bridge.

articles.title: Uttarakhand: Boulder Crashes Down Hill, Misses Vehicles by Inches – Parking Plan Under Scrutiny
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Purola, Uttarakhand – A major mishap was avoided today after a massive boulder rolled down a hill in the Purola Municipal Council area. The rock crossed the road, smashed through a wooden structure, and plunged into a gorge.

body.html:
Purola, Uttarakhand – A major mishap was avoided today after a massive boulder rolled down a hill in the Purola Municipal Council area. The rock crossed the road, smashed through a wooden structure, and plunged into a gorge.

Luckily, no pedestrians or vehicles were on the road at the time. The boulder narrowly missed cars parked nearby, averting a possible tragedy.

The local administration sealed off the site and launched an inquiry into the hill’s stability. The incident has sparked concerns over the safety of the council’s new parking plan.

articles.title: Car Driver Brutally Assaulted for Stopping Wrong-Side Biker
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Pune – A shocking case of road rage in Khadki has sparked outrage after a car driver was brutally beaten for stopping a biker riding on the wrong side of the road. The incident took place on Monday around 5:30 PM and was caught on video, which has since gone viral.

body.html:
Pune – A shocking case of road rage in Khadki has sparked outrage after a car driver was brutally beaten for stopping a biker riding on the wrong side of the road. The incident took place on Monday around 5:30 PM and was caught on video, which has since gone viral.

According to journalist Steffy Thevar, two bikers first attacked the driver, and soon two more joined in. The victim was thrashed so badly that his shirt was soaked in blood. A CT scan later revealed a nasal bone fracture and damage to the anterior bony nasal septum, raising fears of internal injuries.

Shockingly, despite the severity of the assault, Khadki Police registered only a non-cognisable (NC) offence, triggering public anger. Thevar questioned the response, asking: “WHAT DEFINES INTENSITY? How is this not enough for an FIR?”

Concerns have also been raised about the emergency helpline, as the victim reportedly received only an automated message when dialing 100, instead of immediate assistance.

The case has ignited widespread debate on social media over lawlessness on city roads, poor police response, and the urgent need for stricter legal action against road rage.

articles.title: Chandauli: Peepal Tree Branch Falls on Auto, 5 Injured; Driver Referred to BHU Trauma Centre
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Chandauli, UP – A major accident took place on Sunday afternoon near Jethamalpur village in Syedraja area when a thick branch of a peepal tree fell on a moving auto-rickshaw.

body.html:
Chandauli, UP – A major accident took place on Sunday afternoon near Jethamalpur village in Syedraja area when a thick branch of a peepal tree fell on a moving auto-rickshaw.

The auto driver, Om Prakash (40) of Rampur, along with passengers Sita (40), Shubham Prajapati (12), an unidentified boy (10), and Sunaina (50), sustained serious injuries. All were rushed to the district hospital by ambulance.

Doctors, citing his critical condition, referred driver Om Prakash to BHU Trauma Centre. Sunaina was later shifted by relatives to a private hospital.

Police, led by Syedraja SHO Vindeshwari Prasad Pandey, reached the spot immediately and confirmed that all five injured were admitted for treatment. The incident drew a large crowd of onlookers at the site.

articles.title: Odisha YouTuber Swept Away at Duduma Waterfall While Filming Drone Reel
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Koraput, Odisha – In a tragic accident, 22-year-old YouTuber Sagar Tudu (aka Sagar Kundu) from Berhampur was swept away by strong currents at Duduma Waterfall on August 23 while shooting drone footage for his channel.

body.html:
Koraput, Odisha – In a tragic accident, 22-year-old YouTuber Sagar Tudu (aka Sagar Kundu) from Berhampur was swept away by strong currents at Duduma Waterfall on August 23 while shooting drone footage for his channel.

Sagar, who had around 500 subscribers and focused on local culture, was filming with a friend when authorities at the nearby Machakunda dam released nearly 2,000 cusecs of water due to heavy rainfall. The sudden surge caught him off guard as he stood on a rock. Despite efforts by tourists and friends to pull him to safety with ropes, he was dragged away by the torrent.

Police, fire services and ODRAF teams immediately began search operations, but rescue efforts have been hampered by rough terrain and powerful waters. As of the latest updates, his body is yet to be traced.

The incident has reignited debate on the risks of “reel culture” and unsafe stunts at tourist sites. Locals are demanding stricter safety measures and barricades at Duduma, especially during monsoon releases. This is the second such tragedy at the falls in recent months.
